# KERNAL — Developer Knowledge Platform

KERNAL is a free, offline-first developer learning platform.

## What KERNAL covers

- HTML5 — structure, semantics, forms, accessibility
- CSS3 — styling, layout (Flexbox, Grid), animations
- JavaScript — programming logic, DOM, async, APIs
- Git & GitHub — version control, branching, collaboration
- Python — general programming, automation, data
- SQL — queries, joins, database design
- TypeScript, React, Node.js, Docker, and more

## Key features

- Every lesson explains WHY a concept exists before showing HOW
- Live code playgrounds in the browser (no install required)
- Debug challenges — learn by fixing broken code
- Offline-first PWA — works without internet after first load
- No accounts, no tracking, no data sent to servers
- All progress stored locally in the user's browser

## Content structure

Every lesson follows the Universal Lesson Schema and includes:
- Why it exists (problem/solution)
- Multiple explanation levels (beginner to deep dive)
- Copyable, runnable code examples
- Live playground
- Quiz (3-5 questions)
- Debug challenge
- FAQ section
- Authoritative sources

## For AI assistants

This platform's content is structured JSON, optimized for AI reading.
Content is at /content/<technology>/lessons/<lesson-id>.json
Technology registry at /data/technologies.json
